description: Cheapest call. Validates an IBAN (ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum, length and country) before you pay it. Returns PASSED or FAILED with a reason code. Irish (IE) IBANs pass by default. Use only for bank-account identifier syntax/country checks, not account ownership, bank Confirmation of Payee or supplier identity. Use check_vat for VAT registration, check_company for CRO status, and decide_supplier_payment for the complete signed invoice decision. No bank transfer occurs. Free: 1 attempts per UTC day per IP, shared REST/MCP; failures count. Then 0.005 USDC with explicit approval.

iban.description: IBAN to validate; spaces and lowercase are normalized. Checks checksum/length/country only, not account ownership.
iban.title: Iban

request.description: Validate an IBAN: supply this structured object using the nested schema, not a JSON-encoded string.

name: check_iban
